fusions.name: Sluggish Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a cold, heavy mesh that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Leaden] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail-Whip Coil
fusions.desc: Whips your tail and the mesh coiled on it around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Drab Cover
fusions.desc: You lie still beneath a mesh and are veiled for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shed What Was Caught
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you shed the part of you the enemy has caught and regrow it, regaining 4 health a second for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
